movement.title: Moving and looking
movement.text: Move with {key:move_forward}{key:move_left}{key:move_back}{key:move_right} or left-click the floor. Hold the right mouse button and drag to orbit the camera, and use the wheel to zoom. {key:camera_left}/{key:camera_right} also rotate the view.

interaction.title: Interacting
interaction.text: Hover over things to see what they are, then left-click to use them, or press {key:interact} for the nearest object or person. The acting character is always the one you control; their skills decide checks.

inventory.title: Inventory and equipment
inventory.text: Open the inventory with {key:menu_inventory}. The party shares one inventory, but each character equips their own gear. Each character has two weapon sets; swap between them with {key:swap_weapons}.

muster.title: Muster points
muster.text: Muster points are safe spots. Use one to change which companions are active, rest to full health and energy when no enemies are near, and talk to your companions.

combat_basics.title: Tactical combat
combat_basics.text: Combat runs in real time with pause. Press {key:pause} to freeze everything and plan. Click an enemy to target it; with an empty queue your character keeps attacking it. Each action takes one 3-second round.

queue.title: Action queue
queue.text: Each character holds up to four queued actions; actions 1-0 on the bar add to the queue. You can queue, cancel (✕) and reorder (◀ ▶) while paused or running. {key:clear_queue} clears the controlled character's queue.

healing.title: Healing
healing.text: Medpacs heal organics and repair kits fix machines. Using either takes that character's action for the round, so you cannot chain them instantly. Out of combat, health and energy regenerate slowly, and downed allies get back up when the fight ends.

after_first_fight.title: The combat log
after_first_fight.text: Every roll is in the combat log (bottom left, {key:toggle_log} to expand); hover a line to see each modifier. Basic attacks never cost resources, so you can always keep fighting.

stealth.title: Stealth
stealth.text: Press {key:toggle_stealth} to sneak. Enemies who can see you make Awareness checks against your Stealth; distance, line of sight, shadows and standing still all help you. The STEALTH readout shows how close they are to noticing you. Your companions hold position while you sneak alone (Settings → Gameplay).

skills_world.title: Skills on the ship
skills_world.text: Locked doors, terminals, mines and machinery offer skill options showing the DC and your chance. A failure has a cost, but there is always another way: another party member, another skill, force, or a different route.

party_control.title: Party control
party_control.text: Press {key:switch_character} or click a portrait to take control of a companion. Companions you don't control follow their behaviour (set it in the Party screen, {key:menu_party}). Orders you give always override their AI. {key:party_hold} toggles follow/hold; {key:solo_mode} toggles solo mode.

crafting.title: Crafting
crafting.text: Workbenches turn technical components into grenades, mines, repair kits and weapon upgrades. Medical fabricators turn reagents into medpacs and stimulants. Recipes are gated by the crafter's skill, so pick the right party member before you open the bench.

hazards.title: Hazards
hazards.text: Live deck plates and venting coolant hurt anyone standing in them. Awareness reveals hidden hazards, and the right gear (respirators, insulation) or a skill solution can neutralise them.

forms.title: Combat forms
forms.text: Resonance users can adopt a form from the HUD. Ember trades defense for damage, Bastion trades damage for defense, and Tide speeds energy recovery in combat.

levelup.title: Levelling up
levelup.text: When a character has enough experience, a LEVEL UP button appears on their portrait. You can pick every choice yourself or press Recommended at any step.

dialogue_checks.title: Conversation checks
dialogue_checks.text: Tagged options show the skill, the DC and your chance. Options marked with a companion's name use that companion's skill. Resonance options spend energy and add a bonus, but forcing a mind has consequences.
